name: KuCoin
rootCause: After what was described as an “unplanned movement of funds” on September 26th, Kucoin has reassured their users that all assets stolen in the hack will be returned and that Kucoin is fully insured for this scenario.

descriptions.text: After what was described as an “unplanned movement of funds” on September 26th, Kucoin has reassured their users that all assets stolen in the hack will be returned and that Kucoin is fully insured for this scenario.

KuCoin exchange issued an announcement stating that KuCoin detected large withdrawals of Bitcoin and ERC-20 tokens in multiple hot wallets in the early morning of the 26th, and the deposit and withdrawal services have been suspended. KuCoin stated that the total amount involved in the KuCoin platform accounts for a relatively low proportion of the total funds held on the KuCoin platform, and the assets in the KuCoin cold wallet are not affected. At the same time, KuCoin has redeployed the hot wallet for the first time. KuCoin officially stated that if any user suffers losses in this incident, KuCoin and its insurance fund will be fully borne by KuCoin.…

KuCoin’s hot-wallet private keys were compromised in late September 2020, allowing unauthorized withdrawals across Bitcoin, Ethereum and several other networks. KuCoin later said it recovered or covered the affected assets through freezes, token swaps, judicial recovery and insurance. Leak of KuCoin hot-wallet private keys. KuCoin said the attackers could withdraw from hot wallets after the compromise, but it did not publicly establish the exact exfiltration path.
